items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. Retain the three evidence-backed opportunities as deferred backlog: deeppenetrations.com CTR refinement (95 impressions, position 2.8, 0 clicks), broadwayshowgirls.com CTR refinement (64 impressions, position 2, 0 clicks), and americastrikes.com mobile diagnosis (performance 65, LCP 4,861ms, TBT 492ms). These are prioritization signals, not revenue or causal-lift evidence. With 47 failure follow-ups open, 28 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 2 proven outcomes in the 30-day scorecard, create no new production work, requeues, experiments, telemetry, spend, or monetization changes. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission, not site-attributable; margin and ROI remain unknown. Smallest next step: complete existing repair, measurement, and evidence work. Owner decision: after human-counsel review, authorize the prepared Woot permission request or keep it unsent.

Handoff: retain the CRO and product-manager evidence as deferred backlog only. Reject any interpretation of impressions, rankings, CTR targets, performance scores, sessions, conversions, or AI usage as financial return. Do not create duplicate proposals or implementation requests until failure-containment, validation, rollback, deduplication, and measurement gates clear.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and external outreach unsent. Official Woot materials establish API access mechanics but not public or commercial reuse rights; all four legal launch tasks remain open, while security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete. The smallest next step is the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix; no new research request or duplicate data request is needed.
